outcome: neonatal intensive care unit stay of more than 5 days
cohort: The study included 188 pregnant women, divided into groups with pregestational diabetes mellitus (PGDM), gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), and a healthy control group.
finding: A pathological reduction in the ductus venosus (DV) shunt fraction reflects changes in fetal hemodynamics in pregestational diabetes mellitus (PGDM) pregnancies and is associated with an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: A pathological reduction in DV shunt fraction was associated with an increased risk of emergency cesarean section.
